publisher: Psychological Assessment Resources (NEO-PI-R manual), as transcribed in the psychTools R package 2.6.4 dataset neo
title: NEO correlation matrix from the NEO_PI_R manual
universe: 1,000 adults in the manual's normative sample
limits: Read from data/neo.rda in psychTools_2.6.4.tar.gz; only the two cells the game uses are kept. Facet correlations stand in for the five temperament dimensions, which have no norms of their own.
use: The two personality correlation rows in src/core2/data/parameters.json, with Fisher 95% intervals for N = 1,000 as their spreads (checked by scripts/research/people-parameters-check.ts).
